recording.description: Pati begins in the city of Saltillo, going back to prehistoric time at Museo del Desierto, where scientists Regina Gonzlez and Karina Lozano explain the delicate ecosystem that sustains life in Coahuila. Then she suits up for ranch life in a new cowboy outfit for a traditional cabrito lunch with Chef Juan Ramn Cardenas at his ranch. Recipes: Machacado con Huevo - Machaca Egg Scramble Rosas de Strudel de Manzana con Hojaldre - Apple Strudel Flower Puffs
recording.title: Pati's Mexican Table
recording.subtitle: From Dinosaurs to Cowboys

recording.description: Christopher Kimball travels to Paris and finds his new favorite dessert: Rice Pudding with Caramel Cream and Almond Praline. Plus, the Milk Street team refreshes an old classic with a recipe for Cold-Oven Creme Brulee and whips up a 1-2-3-4 Yogurt Cake that uses a yogurt container as the measuring cup.
recording.title: Christopher Kimball's Milk Street Television
recording.subtitle: New French Desserts

recording.description: Test cook Dan Souza makes Gua Bao (Taiwanese steamed buns with braised pork belly) for host Julia Collin Davison. Tasting expert Jack Bishop and host Bridget Lancaster review hoisin sauce. And test cook Maggie Zhu prepares a Quick Taiwanese Pork Rice.
recording.title: America's Test Kitchen
recording.subtitle: Taiwanese Staples

recording.description: Test cook Bryan Roof prepares Slow-Roasted Ducks with Blackberry Sauce for host Toni Tipton-Martin. Tasting expert Jack Bishop breaks down the best uses for different tinned fish. And test cook Lawman Johnson makes a rich Bean Bourguignon for host Julia Collin Davison.
recording.title: Cook's Country
recording.subtitle: Elevated Friendsgiving Mains

recording.description: Christopher Kimball goes on a fishing trip off the Pacific Coast of Mexico to learn the art of Mexican seafood. Back at Milk Street, he prepares Slow-Roasted Snapper with Chili and Lime. Plus, Matt Card makes Mexican-Style Shrimp in Chili-Lime Sauce, Rosemary Gill gives a lesson on Chilis 101 and we visit Santiago Muñoz at his tortilleria Maizajo to learn the secret to amazing heirloom tortillas.
recording.title: Christopher Kimball's Milk Street Television
recording.subtitle: Mexico's Riviera

recording.description: This hugely successful, multi-Emmy-winning sitcom is set in a friendly Boston bar run by Sam Malone, a former Red Sox pitcher and recovering alcoholic. A brilliantly written and performed ensemble comedy filled with colorful characters, the series, in its first five years, revolved around the on again-off again, dysfunctional romance between Sam and brainy waitress Diane. The series bowed in September 1982, ran for 11 seasons and spun off another all-time classic, 'Frasier.'
recording.title: Cheers

Tasting expert Jack Bishop challenges Bridget and host Julia Collin Davison to a tasting of frozen puff pastries. And test cook Erica Turner makes Julia buttery Ma'amoul, or semolina cookies.
recording.title: America's Test Kitchen
recording.subtitle: Pan-Seared Halibut and Ma'amoul

recording.description: Test cook Ashley Moore makes Jitto's-Style Steak Bombs for host Bridget Lancaster. Tasting expert Jack Bishop reviews the world of squash. Toni Tipton-Martin shares the origins of different sandwich names. And test cook Bryan Roof hits the road to Brookline and makes host Julia Collin Davison a Cutty's-Inspired Eggplant Spuckie.
recording.title: Cook's Country
recording.subtitle: New England Sandwiches

recording.description: James gets more than he expected when he becomes the attending veterinarian at the Hensfield dog track. Meanwhile, Tristan visits Mrs. Ainsley and her cheeky parrot, and Jimmy inadvertently shares some hard truths with Siegfried.
recording.title: All Creatures Great and Small on Masterpiece
recording.collectionTitle: All Creatures Great and Small on Masterpiece
recording.subtitle: Fixes

recording.description: Helen struggles when Jenny gets some exciting news. Tristan doubts himself when he tries to fit into Charlotte's world. Elsewhere, Siegfried meets his match in a particularly stubborn goat.
recording.title: All Creatures Great and Small on Masterpiece
recording.collectionTitle: All Creatures Great and Small on Masterpiece
recording.subtitle: Jenny Wren

recording.description: Tristan and Siegfried find themselves in competition to treat the horse of a wealthy family that's new to the area. Mrs. Pumphrey and James prepare Tricki for a special visitor, and Mrs. Hall uncovers a surprising secret of Tristan's.
recording.title: All Creatures Great and Small on Masterpiece
recording.collectionTitle: All Creatures Great and Small on Masterpiece
recording.subtitle: Captain Farnon?

recording.description: Tension sparks when James buys an X-ray machine for practice, challenging Siegfried's traditional methods. Mrs. Hall learns more about Siegfried's shenanigans, and Mrs. Pumphrey seeks advice from the team when Tricki seems unusually distant.
recording.title: All Creatures Great and Small on Masterpiece
recording.collectionTitle: All Creatures Great and Small on Masterpiece
recording.subtitle: Old Dog, New Tricks

recording.description: Things look very different at Skeldale House as James grapples with Siegfried's wild and chaotic energy. Tristan returns from war, and he and James take matters into their own hands. Amid the upheaval, there may be good news just around the corner.
recording.title: All Creatures Great and Small on Masterpiece
recording.collectionTitle: All Creatures Great and Small on Masterpiece
recording.subtitle: Gathering the Flock

recording.description: Patience and Frankie are held hostage by an escaped prisoner seeking justice. As armed police prepare to storm the building, Frankie's past resurfaces. Meanwhile Patience realizes she's ready to be honest about her feelings for Elliot.
recording.title: Patience
recording.subtitle: Hostage

recording.description: Christopher Kimball searches Paris for new spins on bistro classics, starting with a surprising take on French Onion Soup. Back at Milk Street, Rose Hattabaugh makes Oven-Baked Three-Layer Croque Monsieur Sandwiches, a fuss-free recipe that's doable on any night of the week. Finally, Rosemary Gill prepares a modern twist on garlic bread: Garlic Toasts with Goat Cheese and Herb Salad.
recording.title: Christopher Kimball's Milk Street Television
recording.subtitle: New Bistro Classics

recording.description: Test cook Erica Turner makes host Bridget Lancaster Chicken Yassa (Senegalese Braised Chicken with Caramelized Onion and Lemon). Tasting expert Jack Bishop challenges Bridget and host Julia Collin Davison to a tasting of chicken broths. And test cook Becky Hays prepares Peruvian Arroz con Pollo for Julia.
recording.title: America's Test Kitchen
recording.subtitle: Two Takes on Chicken and Rice

recording.description: Test cook Ashley Moore bakes delicious Double-Chocolate Banana Bread for host Julia Collin Davison. Toni Tipton-Martin talks about the history of bananas in the United States and the recipes that came from them. Equipment expert Hannah Crowley reviews cold-brew coffee makers, and test cook Christie Morrison makes host Bridget Lancaster Chocolate Brownie Cookies.
recording.title: Cook's Country
recording.subtitle: Chocolate Baked Delights

recording.description: A monk is found dead, kneeling in prayer. Patience and Frankie investigate and secrets surface at the monastery. Meanwhile, Patience finds herself on stage as the face of City of York police and starts rethinking her decision about Elliot.
recording.title: Patience
recording.subtitle: A Monk's Tale

recording.description: Test cook Lan Lam shows Julia Collin Davison how to build a showstopping Ice Cream Cake. And science expert Dan Souza reveals the unexpected powers of melting ice.
recording.title: America's Test Kitchen
recording.subtitle: Ice Cream Cake

recording.description: Test cook Lawman Johnson makes host Julia Collin Davison the ultimate Pickle-Brined Fried Chicken Sandwich. Tasting expert Jack Bishop takes a deep dive into cucumbers. Toni Tipton-Martin shares the story behind MoonPies. Test cook Morgan Bolling shows host Bridget Lancaster how to make Chocolate-Marshmallow Sandwich Cookies.
recording.title: Cook's Country
recording.subtitle: Southern Sandwiches

recording.description: A woman is found dead in the botanical gardens. Was she murdered or did she die of natural causes? Patience suspects foul play and falls out with Frankie who needs convincing. Meanwhile Patience tries to deny her feelings for Elliot.
recording.title: Patience
recording.subtitle: Paco's Revenge

recording.description: Spain vs. Argentina in the Final in East Rutherford, N.J. Lionel Messi and La Albiceleste (white and sky blue) look to join Italy (1934-38) and Brazil (1958-62) as back-to-back World Cup champions, but must overcome teenage star Lamine Yamal and a streaking Spanish side whose 37-match unbeaten run includes the Euro 2024 title. Shakira, Justin Bieber, Madonna and BTS perform at halftime.
recording.title: 2026 FIFA World Cup
recording.subtitle: Final: Spain vs. Argentina

recording.description: España vs. Argentina en la gran Final del Campeonato Mundial de la FIFA 2026. Desde Estadio Nueva York/Nueva Jersey en Nueva Jersey, USA. España, respaldada por su solidez defensiva durante el torneo y el talento de Lamine Yamal, intentará levantar la segunda Copa Mundial de su historia. La Albiceleste, liderada por la leyenda argentina Lionel Messi, disputa su segunda final consecutiva y busca hacer historia al conquistar nuevamente el título.
recording.title: Copa Mundial de la FIFA 2026
recording.subtitle: España vs. Argentina

recording.description: A Viking expert dies before a big controversial speech and Patience finds a coded message hinting at foul play. As another scholar is targeted, she and Frankie race to uncover the truth. And her relationship with Elliot hits the rocks.
recording.title: Patience
recording.subtitle: The Runes

recording.description: France vs. England in the Third-Place Match in Miami, Fla. Coach Didier Deschamps ends his 14-year tenure with France with a third straight trip to the World Cup's final weekend, albeit a consolation match against a far-more heartbroken England, which allowed two late goals to Argentina in the semis after going up 1-0. The Three Lions lost previous third-place matches in 1990 and 2018.
recording.title: 2026 FIFA World Cup
recording.subtitle: Third-Place Match: France vs. England

recording.description: Test cook Keith Dresser prepares host Bridget Lancaster a hearty German Farmer's Breakfast (Bauernfrühstück). Equipment expert Adam Ried reviews cookie sheets. And Bridget makes host Julia Collin Davison a delicious Appeltaart (Dutch Apple Pie).
recording.title: America's Test Kitchen
recording.subtitle: Farmer's Brunch

recording.description: Test cook Morgan Bolling makes Indoor Barbecued Ribs for host Julia Collin Davison. Equipment expert Hannah Crowley reviews panini presses. Toni Tipton-Martin shares the origins of jalapeño poppers, and test cook Lawman Johnson shows host Bridget Lancaster how to make them in the air fryer.
recording.title: Cook's Country
recording.subtitle: Bar Snacks, Perfected

recording.description: England vs. Argentina in a semifinal in Atlanta, Ga. Iconic soccer powers from Europe and South America rekindle their eventful World Cup history, which England leads 3-2 after a 2002 group-stage win. Extra-time goals by Jude Bellingham and Julian Alvarez allowed the teams to escape the quarterfinals, with Lionel Messi and La Albiceleste extending their World Cup winning streak to 12 matches. Thomas Tuchel's Brits are bidding for their first trip to the final since hoisting the trophy in 1966.
recording.title: 2026 FIFA World Cup
recording.subtitle: Semifinal: England vs. Argentina

recording.description: France vs. Spain in a semifinal in Arlington, Texas. Kylian Mbappe (eight goals) and France bid for their third straight World Cup final, but must overcome a Spanish side that's let in one goal in the tournament and is riding a 36-match unbeaten streak. La Roja's run includes the Euro 2024 title in which they defeated Les Bleus in the semis. Lamine Yamal (turned 19 yesterday) paces Spain's attack.
recording.title: 2026 FIFA World Cup
recording.subtitle: Semifinal: France vs. Spain

recording.description: Argentina vs. Switzerland in a quarterfinal in Kansas City, Mo. Lionel Messi (eight goals) and Argentina ride a remarkable 11-match World Cup win streak back to K.C., where a Messi hat trick (vs. Algeria) began their title defense last month. Round of 16 penalty-kick hero Ruben Vargas and captain Granit Xhaka stoke the Swiss, who last made the quarterfinals in 1954, as World Cup hosts.
recording.title: 2026 FIFA World Cup
recording.subtitle: Quarterfinal: Argentina vs. Switzerland

recording.description: Norway vs. England in a quarterfinal in Miami, Fla. Thomas Tuchel's Three Lions arrive from their wild 3-2 conquest of co-host Mexico looking to book their fourth trip to the semifinals, while Norway and its legion of Viking fans row to their first quarterfinals. Jude Bellingham (on feeds from Bukayo Saka and Harry Kane) and Norwegian big man Erling Haaland both scored twice in the previous round.
recording.title: 2026 FIFA World Cup
recording.subtitle: Quarterfinal: Norway vs. England

recording.description: Test cook Vallery Lomas makes host Bridget Lancaster a savory Turkey Sausage Lasagna. Tasting expert Jack Bishop talks all about sugar. And test cook Antoinette Johnson makes a refreshing Chocolate Sorbet for host Julia Collin Davison.
recording.title: America's Test Kitchen
recording.subtitle: Turkey Lasagna and Chocolate Sorbet

recording.description: Test cook Ashley Moore makes host Bridget Lancaster Frito Pie. Tasting expert Jack Bishop challenges Bridget to a tasting of nonalcoholic beer. Toni Tipton-Martin shares the story of the Potato Chip Queen of the West. And test cook Morgan Bolling whips up Chocolate-Dipped Potato Chip Cookies for host Julia Collin Davison.
recording.title: Cook's Country
recording.subtitle: Chips on the Menu

recording.description: Spain vs. Belgium in a quarterfinal in Los Angeles, Cal. The first of two all-European quarterfinals finds Rudi Garcia's Belgium looking to breach a Spanish goal that's been kept clean through all five matches this World Cup. Lamine Yamal sparks La Roja's attack three days from turning 19, while 33-year-old Romelu Lukaku is a looming threat for a Belgian squad paced by captain Youri Tielemans.
recording.title: 2026 FIFA World Cup
recording.subtitle: Quarterfinal: Spain vs. Belgium

recording.description: France vs. Morocco in a quarterfinal in Foxborough, Mass. Kylian Mbappe's seven goals are one shy of his Golden Boot-winning total from 2022 as Les Bleus square off with Morocco in a rematch from that year's semifinals, where Didier Dechamps' side prevailed 2-0. Paris Saint-Germain right back Achraf Hakimi anchors the Moroccan backline and aids Brahim Diaz (four assists) in triggering the offense.
recording.title: 2026 FIFA World Cup
recording.subtitle: Quarterfinal I: France vs. Morocco

recording.description: When a prominent couple is found dead, is it a copycat crime, or was the wrong man tried?
recording.title: Professor T
recording.subtitle: The Mask Murders

recording.description: Switzerland vs. Colombia in a Round of 16 match in Vancouver, B.C. Coach Nestor Lorenzo's Los Cafeteros head north of the border on a run of three straight shutouts, to face Ligue 1 forward Breel Embolo and a Swiss side that has made itself at home in Vancouver the last two weeks in wins over Canada and Algeria. Colombia won the previous Cup meeting 2-0 in the 1994 group stage at Stanford, but only the Swiss advanced to knockouts.
recording.title: 2026 FIFA World Cup
recording.subtitle: Round of 16: Switzerland vs. Colombia

recording.description: Argentina vs. Egypt in a Round of 16 match in Atlanta, Ga. Two of the biggest stars in the soccer galaxy collide as Lionel Messi and reigning champ Argentina take on Mo Salah and the first Egyptian side to make the final 16 since 1934's 16-team event. La Albiceleste's 10-match World Cup win streak survived a scare vs. Cape Verde, while Egypt used a perfect penalty round to get by Australia.
recording.title: 2026 FIFA World Cup
recording.subtitle: Round of 16: Argentina vs. Egypt

recording.description: U.S. vs. Belgium in a Round of 16 match in Seattle, Wash. Team USA rides the momentum from a 2-0 win over Bosnia north for their fifth straight West Coast match, looking to end a run of World Cup exits in this round that includes a 2-1 extra-time loss to Belgium in 2014. Despite a red card vs. Bosnia, Folarin Balogun is active, to help match the veteran Belgian forwards paced by Kevin De Bruyne.
recording.title: 2026 FIFA World Cup
recording.subtitle: Round of 16: U.S. vs. Belgium

recording.description: Portugal vs. Spain in a Round of 16 match in Arlington, Texas. Co-hosts of the 2030 World Cup collide for a berth in the quarterfinals, furthering their Iberian rivalry with a third World Cup meeting. Portugal's ageless Cristiano Ronaldo was involved in both previous games, a 1-0 Spain round-of-16 win in 2010 and a 3-3 draw in the 2018 group stage. La Roja have outscored their last three foes 8-0.
recording.title: 2026 FIFA World Cup
recording.subtitle: Round of 16: Portugal vs. Spain

recording.description: Mexico vs. England in a Round of 16 match in Mexico City. After a dominant Round of 32 win, El Tri (0 goals allowed in four games) keeps home-field advantage at Estadio Azteca as Raúl Jiménez leads the team's bid for its first World Cup quarterfinal in 40 years. England and Harry Kane (5 goals) had to rally late past DR Congo to set up this first meeting with Mexico since their title year of 1966.
recording.title: 2026 FIFA World Cup
recording.subtitle: Round of 16: Mexico vs. England

recording.description: Brazil vs. Norway in a Round of 16 match in East Rutherford, N.J. The Seleção looks to take another step toward the title with Vinícius Jr., who has scored four goals in the tournament. Landslaget, led by Erling Haaland and his five goals, aims to keep making history against a world powerhouse.
recording.title: 2026 FIFA World Cup
recording.subtitle: Round of 16: Brazil vs. Norway

recording.description: Paraguay vs. France in a Round of 16 match in Philadelphia, Pa. La Albirroja enters the Round of 16 as one of the World Cup's biggest surprises, fueled by a historic Round of 32 win and Orlando Gill's presence in goal. Les Bleus counter with Kylian Mbappé in star form, leading the way with six goals, and Michael Olise emerging as a breakout player in pursuit of another step toward the title.
recording.title: 2026 FIFA World Cup
recording.subtitle: Round of 16: Paraguay vs. France

recording.description: Test cook Becky Hays makes host Julia Collin Davison Cachapas con Queso de Mano (Venezuelan Cheese-Filled Corn Cakes). Equipment expert Adam Ried reviews dish towels, and science expert Dan Souza uses physics to demonstrate the importance of a sharp knife. Finally, test cook Joe Gitter makes host Bridget Lancaster Fresh Corn Chowder.
recording.title: America's Test Kitchen
recording.subtitle: Corn Cakes and Chowder

recording.description: Test cook Morgan Bolling makes host Bridget Lancaster the ultimate Porchetta Abruzzese. Toni Tipton-Martin talks about pig farming in early North America. Tasting expert Jack Bishop talks all about hardy greens. And test cook Christie Morrison prepares a Quick-Braised Broccoli Rabe with Garlic and Anchovies for host Julia Collin Davison.
recording.title: Cook's Country
recording.subtitle: Italian-American Feast

recording.description: Canada vs. Morocco in a Round of 16 match in Houston, Texas. Les Rouges enter the Round of 16 with Stephen Eustáquio driving the midfield after completing 215 passes, and Jonathan David leading the team with three goals. The Atlas Lions counter with Ismael Saibari, who has scored three goals, and Brahim Díaz, their creative leader with two assists, as they look for another World Cup statement.
recording.title: 2026 FIFA World Cup
recording.subtitle: Round of 16: Canada vs. Morocco

recording.title: Copa Mundial de la FIFA 2026
